invariants.requirement: UI and chat share authoritative application services.
invariants.executableTestOwner: host-provider identity integration plus real stdio/UI journey
assertions: no independent database or second host

invariants.requirement: Window lease does not authorize backend work or own task execution.
assertions: backend read/mutation works with no lease
revocation does not invoke task cancellation
lease grant changes no backend permissions

invariants.requirement: Only interactive UI authority can accept.
Each lease binds exact host, UI, agent and scope.
assertions: wrong host/UI incarnation, session, scope or generation rejected

invariants.requirement: A window has at most one activating or active controller.
assertions: parallel accepts have one reservation winner

invariants.requirement: Local revoke returns manual controls before host acknowledgment.
assertions: gate/fence/control state changes before deferred transport settles

invariants.requirement: No delayed revoked presentation effect may apply.
assertions: new lease cannot consume old queue

invariants.requirement: Revoking the window preserves independently authorized backend work/chat.
Normal UI data updates continue after detach.
Local revoke stops new context and pending producers.
assertions: held producer publishes zero fresh context
already transmitted bytes explicitly outside guarantee

invariants.requirement: Ended leases are terminal; fresh control needs fresh acceptance.
assertions: new request and click create new authority

invariants.requirement: Late grants and stale revokes cannot override newer local decisions.
assertions: attempt plus captured local fence rejects late grant
old immutable revoke target does not end new lease

invariants.requirement: Dirty drafts retain their immutable base until explicit resolution.
assertions: new list metadata cannot update draft base

invariants.requirement: Backend targets are explicit after detach.
assertions: human workspace switch changes no agent task target

invariants.requirement: Business and presentation outcomes remain separate.
invariants.executableTestOwner: prospective MCP result mapping/skill tests and prospective dev-tools/scripts/qualification/visual-composer/e2e/packaged-desktop-ui-takeover.e2e.spec.ts
assertions: saved mutation stays succeeded when reveal detached
no business retry for presentation failure

invariants.requirement: Business retry and UI delivery use distinct deduplication.
Takeover adds no backend permission and bypasses no approval.
invariants.executableTestOwner: application authorization and exact-source workflow denial tests

invariants.requirement: Recovery defaults to manual unless current authority is proven.
assertions: new UI incarnation rejects old traffic

acceptanceScenarios.requirement: Authorized read without a UI lease.

assertions: agent credential denied before reservation mutation
exact window/workspace activated only after ready

acceptanceScenarios.requirement: Second agent requests a controlled window.
Old revoke arrives after new accepted lease.
Delivered command reaches effect after revoke.
assertions: captured local fence fails at final effect commit
preview does not open or steal focus
generation guard suppresses effect even when cancellation double does not abort

acceptanceScenarios.executableTestOwner: held real connector save plus UI journey
existing task use-case/connector integration and real host journey

assertions: agent work remains scoped to original explicit workspace

acceptanceScenarios.requirement: New metadata/revision reaches a dirty editor.
assertions: exact dirty values and undo preserved
neither draft nor other writer overwritten

acceptanceScenarios.executableTestOwner: prospective modules/adapters/persistence/automation/tests/operation-receipts.integration.test.ts and real connector lost-response test

acceptanceScenarios.requirement: Idempotency key reused for changed input.
assertions: no second effect or result disclosure

acceptanceScenarios.requirement: Old queued messages meet a new lease.
Command or replay targets foreign scope.
acceptanceScenarios.executableTestOwner: transport/application scope denial and managed RLS tests
assertions: no protected payload or identity leak

acceptanceScenarios.executableTestOwner: prospective PostgreSQL two-worker crash/replay integration; SQLite restart integration
assertions: dispatch resumes to subscribers on both workers

acceptanceScenarios.executableTestOwner: MCP result mapping and skill behavior tests
assertions: business success + failed/detached presentation reported separately

acceptanceScenarios.requirement: Revoke during loading and ordinary dialogs.
Refetch replies complete in reverse order.
acceptanceScenarios.executableTestOwner: extend modules/ui/shared/system-builder/tests/SystemBuilderWorkspace.interaction.ui.test.tsx plus shared synchronization held-response tests

assertions: old ready cannot activate/displace current reservation

acceptanceScenarios.requirement: Async context completes after local revoke.
assertions: held result publishes zero new values
host queued values discarded once revoke processed

acceptanceScenarios.requirement: Retry after reconnect or changed permissions.
assertions: new chat-session ID does not duplicate

acceptanceScenarios.requirement: Timed-out command finishes after queue advances.
assertions: old command generation invalidated before advancing
same valid lease cannot authorize obsolete callback

sections.coverage: Headless authority, saved-state independence and separate lifecycles
Revalidate current host, API, persistence, Composer and workflow seams
All18 invariant rows above
Application ownership, thin adapters, independent change/presentation/context channels
Same running desktop then same managed server; no hybrid sync/relay
Stable principal/client receipt identity versus live host/UI/agent/attempt/lease identity
Separate logical channels, finite actions and metadata-only context
Explicit product accept/revoke shell and automated tests of its lifecycle
Atomic awaiting-ready reservation and cancellation/grant/readiness race handling
Synchronous local fencing, immutable exact revoke and late callback suppression
Versioned validated contracts, operation-derived transports and separated caller surfaces
Finite tool catalog, portable skill and truthful workflow/task capabilities
Shared semantic edits, immutable draft base and save-or-cancel handoff
Committed outbox, scoped snapshot/cursor/replay/resync and guarded refetch
Durable business retry identity versus per-lease serial presentation dedup
Authentication, delegation, exact scope, privacy, injection resistance and redaction
Expiry, disconnect, new incarnations, multi-window isolation and authorization loss
Deterministic failure oracles mapped to AT cases; no optimistic pass
Existing family seams first, new adapters/ports only with owned responsibilities
Bounded outcome/audit events and host-specific prospective measured targets
All41 scenario rows above with executable ownership
Six reference phases consolidated into three cohesive useful increments
Actual MCP/client + real UI template/task/accept/revoke/continue demonstration automated on both hosts
Recommended defaults are proposal choices; exclusions remain explicit
Current source discovery and current primary protocol/skill documentation

qualificationRules: All test paths marked prospective must be implemented and executed after separate implementation authorization.
Shared deterministic tests prove protocol logic; real packaged Windows and Chrome/server/PostgreSQL tests prove host behavior.

Use an existing supported observable backend operation with a bounded deterministic test runtime where needed. Substitution does not prove native model accuracy, external-provider effects or new crash recovery.
Human product acceptance and revoke are simulated by UI tests. No human acceptance/study task is part of technical closure.
No test, model, application, service, dependency installation or full suite was executed for this planning artifact.

The roadmap is published and approved. The user explicitly deferred implementation. A separate explicit implementation request, current-source reconciliation and preservation of unrelated changes, roadmap history and actual qualification remain required.
